note: Rumble Arena's Korean name is 와글와글 아레나 (gallery shorthand 와레나, 와글레나, 와글 아레나, 전섭/전서버/통합 아레나). The string 럼블 on DCInside only matches the game name 크럼블 (and 크럼블 던전), so the lane searched 와글/와레나 instead. Captures: research/002-pvp-meta/evidence/02-dc-rumble/dc/<id>.md with images in dc/img/. Every date below is 2026. Season 1 ran 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-08.

posts.summary_en: Relays the official KR X announcement: Rumble Arena is a cross-server arena where squads from every server fight. Commenters expect later servers to be disadvantaged, because nobody is grouped into brackets of similar server age.
rules: Cross-server: every server's squads are in one pool (전 서버 모든 용병단이 맞붙는).

quotes.kr: 서버의 경계를 넘어 진짜 최강자를 가릴 대격돌! 전 서버 모든 용병단이 맞붙는 시간
quotes.en: A clash across server borders to decide the true strongest! Every squad on every server fights.

posts.title_en: Is Rumble separate from the existing Arena?
posts.summary_en: Commenters say Rumble Arena is added alongside regular Arena and doesn't replace it. Regular Arena stays per-server; Rumble Arena is all servers combined. Post 71806 gives the same answer.
rules: Two arenas coexist: 일반 아레나 (per-server) and 와글와글 아레나 (all servers).

quotes.kr: 아레나가 기존 서버 내에서 경쟁하는 일반 아레나 / 전 서버 통합으로 경쟁하는 와글와글 아레나 이렇게 2개 되는 거
quotes.en: There are now two: regular Arena within your server, and Rumble Arena across all servers.

posts.title_kr: 기존 서버별 아레나 대체되고 전섭통합 아레나로 바뀌는거??
posts.title_en: Does the unified arena replace per-server Arena?
posts.summary_en: Answer: no. There are two near-identical arenas, 일반 아레나 and 통합 아레나.
rules: Rumble Arena is added alongside regular Arena and doesn't replace it.

posts.summary_en: The poster argues that later servers will only be fodder. Replies say that, like regular Arena, only cookie stars and gear matter. Breakthrough (돌파력), research lab and Stella are said to be excluded, and guild buffs don't apply.
mechanics: Per commenters, PvP power counts cookie stars and gear, but not breakthrough, research or Stella (돌파력 연구소 스텔라 기타등등 다 빠지는데). Low confidence: nobody showed a source.
rules: No server brackets; one global pool.
disagreements: Some commenters call it fair because most growth stats are stripped; others call it unfair because gear and stars favour older accounts.

quotes.kr: 돌파력 연구소 스텔라 기타등등 다 빠지는데
quotes.en: Breakthrough, the research lab, Stella and so on are all excluded.

posts.title_kr: 와글와글은 하스스톤 투기장 느낌으로 나왔으면 좋았을 듯
posts.title_en: Wish Rumble were a Hearthstone-arena-style draft
posts.summary_en: A wish post: a random draft of 12 cookies would make cross-server matches fair. It incidentally says the notice calls Rumble Arena an irregular, event-like mode and that a team is 12 cookies.
rules: Per the poster's reading of the notice, Rumble Arena runs irregularly (비정기적으로 운영하는 컨텐츠). No draft or ban/pick exists: you bring your own roster.

quotes.kr: 공지 보니까 와글와글은 비정기적으로 운영하는 약간 이벤트 컨텐츠 같은데
quotes.en: Going by the notice, Rumble looks like irregular, event-like content.

posts.summary_en: A screenshot of the '격돌! 와글와글 아레나' event page. Daily missions reset at 00:00 and reward 와글와글 메달 (Rumble medals) for 5, 10, 15 and 20 challenges. A 20-step completion track awards 30 cutters, 2,000 medals, 30 pet tickets, 5,000 medals and a final item.
rules: Rumble uses its own entry ticket (와글와글 아레나 입장권).
Event missions: 5/10/15/20 Rumble challenges per day (reset 00:00) pay 100/100/1 medal-pack/200 Rumble medals plus minor items; the event lasted about 20 days from 2026-09-22.

posts.summary_en: Official notice: the maximum number of Rumble Arena tickets was displayed wrongly. The display was only cosmetic; holding, refilling and spending tickets worked normally.
rules: Ticket cap UI bug: showed 8 while the real cap is 5 (see 75128).

quotes.kr: 와글와글 아레나 입장권 최대 보유 개수가 실제 보유 가능한 최대 개수와 다르게 표기되는 현상
quotes.en: Rumble Arena ticket max holding displayed differently from the real maximum.

posts.summary_en: The challenge button shows 5/8 tickets. A reply says the real maximum is 5 and the 8 is the bug.
rules: Free ticket cap is 5; each challenge costs 1 ticket.

quotes.kr: 5개 맥스고 8은 버그
quotes.en: 5 is the max, the 8 is a bug.

posts.summary_en: The poster lost three days of tickets by idling: free tickets refill daily and don't bank. Extra tickets are bought with mileage; the poster bought about 100.
rules: Free tickets refill to the cap daily and don't accumulate past it.
Extra tickets are bought with mileage (마일리지), with no purchase limit (see 73284, 73735).

posts.summary_en: The Rumble Arena shop (와글와글 아레나 상점) sells time-skip items for 350–500 Rumble medals (gems, XP, gold, dough, 3-key bundles, 5–10 per reset). Tickets cost 1,000 mileage each and can be bought without limit; the poster bought the maximum by mistake and spent all his mileage.
rules: Shop currency: 와글와글 메달. Ticket: 1,000 mileage each, unlimited.
The shop resets daily (내일 상점 초기화).

posts.summary_en: Reports the season buff: Charge cookies get +30% max HP, which explains why Bari is strong. A commenter says the buff changes each season.
mechanics: Season 1 buff: Charge-type (돌격형) cookies +30% Max HP.
rules: The Rumble buff is seasonal (시즌제로 버프 바뀜, commenter claim).

quotes.kr: 근데 짜피 시즌제로 버프 바뀜
quotes.en: The buff changes every season anyway.

posts.summary_en: An in-game screenshot of the 와글와글 버프 panel for Season 1 lists two buffs. The first is 'Charge cookie max HP +30%', with the eligible Charge cookies listed. The second is 'All cookies and summons DMG Reduction +30%'. The season-end timer read 14d 17h 11m on 09-23 18:49 KST.
mechanics: Season 1 buff 1: 돌격형 쿠키 최대체력 30% 증가 (Charge cookies Max HP +30%).
Season 1 buff 2: 모든 쿠키와 소환수 피해감소 30% 증가 (all cookies and summons DMG Reduction +30%). This lengthens fights and favours sustain and defense.
rules: Season 1 ends about 2026-10-08 12:00 KST (screenshot timer); crumb.gg's battle_end is 2026-10-08 03:00 UTC, the same moment.

quotes.kr: 모든 쿠키와 소환수 피해감소 30% 증가
quotes.en: All cookies and summons: DMG Reduction +30%.

posts.summary_en: Confirms the two buffs: Charge HP +30% and 30% DMG reduction for all cookies.
mechanics: Both buffs confirmed: Charge HP +30%, all-cookie DMG Reduction +30%.

posts.title_en: Rumble grandmaster cut should be wider
posts.summary_en: A screenshot of the Season 1 season-ranking rewards: 1st 3,200 pts 60,000 gems + 25,000 medals; 2nd 50,000 + 25,000; 3rd 45,000 + 25,000; ≤10th (3,000 pts) 40,000 + 25,000; ≤30th 35,000 + 25,000; ≤100th 30,000 + 25,000. Master League (2,000 pts): top 5% 25,000 + 20,000, top 10% 24,000 + 20,000, top 20% 23,000 + 15,000, top 30% 22,000 + 15,000. Rewards pay out automatically at season end. The screen also has 매일 랭킹 (daily ranking) and 한정 보상 (limited rewards) tabs.
rules: Season ranking rewards pay gems plus Rumble medals, gated by both points (3,200 for top 3; 3,000 for top 100; 2,000 for Master League) and rank or percentile.
There is also a daily ranking (매일 랭킹) and a limited-reward tab (한정 보상).
Top-tier cut is 100 players versus 30 in regular Arena (poster's comparison).

posts.summary_en: The main screen shows the league system. At 2,007 pts the poster is 'Master 5' (마스터 V), rank 3,279, 'Master League top 96.41%'. Promotion needs 2,000 pts and top 80.00%, with a 1,500-gem promotion reward. Top 3 on 09-27 20:11 KST: 凱凱の餅乾軍團 4,001, 군무원 3,965, 날씨의아이 3,889. The attack and defense teams are set separately (both 11.55M here).
rules: Tiered leagues with numbered divisions (Diamond 1 in 73871; Master 5 to Master 1; the top is 챔피언 1, 'max grade reached', in 75168).
Promotion conditions combine points and percentile (e.g. Master 5 → next: 2,000 pts and top 80%), with a gem reward per promotion.
A defense team (방어팀) and an attack team (공격팀) are formed separately; 5 presets are available (74627).

results.note: 凱凱の餅乾軍團 4,001; 군무원 3,965; 날씨의아이 3,889

posts.title_kr: 와레나 한정보상도 없는데 열심히 하는 사람 있음?
posts.title_en: Anyone grinding Rumble with no limited reward? (me)
posts.summary_en: Posted by ㄹㄹ노아 (crumb.gg rank 3 on 09-27), who was then overall #1 (3,406 pts, Champion 1, attack and defense power 27.91M). He says it's pure PvP with no guild effects, so anyone can place. Asked for the Bari and Ion runes, he answered 피감 체력 스증 스가.

builds.sugar_runes: 피감 체력 스증 스가 (DMG reduction, HP, Skill AMP, Skill Haste)
builds.why: Given by the then #1 player when asked for his Bari and Ion runes; no reason stated.

mechanics: No guild-derived effects in Rumble Arena (길드로 영향 주는 요소 없는 순수 PVP), per the #1 player.
rules: Top grade: 챔피언 1 (최대 등급 도달).

quotes.kr: 길드로 영향 주는 요소 없는 순수 PVP니까 누구든 가능하지 않을까?
quotes.en: It's pure PvP with nothing from guilds, so anyone could do it.

quotes.kr: 피감 체력 스증 스가
quotes.en: DMG reduction, HP, Skill AMP, Skill Haste.

posts.summary_en: In the defense log, attackers above 2,000 pts show as '익명의 도전자' (anonymous challenger), with power '????' and levels 'Lv.??'. The lineup and pets are still visible. A defense success gives +1 and a loss −1. The revenge (복수) reward showed about 40–49 points.
rules: At 2,000+ points, names, power and levels are hidden on attack and defense (anti-sniping, per commenters).
Revenge fights are available from the defense log (복수하러 가기).

quotes.kr: 2000점 이상부터는 다 가려지는듯
quotes.en: From 2,000 points up everything is hidden.

posts.summary_en: Screenshots of the defense log. Each successful defense gives +1 or +2 points and +125 Rumble medals; failures cost −1 to −4. The poster's defense is 12 Lv.100 cookies (Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb, Moon Rabbit) with pets Hot Doggie 18, Holy Baby Drop 19, Majestic King Choco Drop 20. He sits at 1,815 pts, rank 2,257.
rules: Defense success: +1 to +2 points and +125 Rumble medals; defense loss: −1 to −4 points.

posts.title_kr: 와레나 메달 모아야 하는데 복수작 할만함?
posts.title_en: Is deliberately losing worth it to farm medals?
posts.summary_en: ㄹㄹ노아 (곰인형) says successful defenses earn more medals than dropping rank on purpose. Others say defense medals are very lucrative.
rules: Defense wins are the main medal source (방어 메달 개달달).

quotes.kr: 그냥 방어 성공하는게 메달 더 범
quotes.en: Just winning defenses earns more medals.

posts.title_kr: 와글 아레나에서 캐릭 하나만 올려놓는 사람들은 왜그러는건가요
posts.title_en: Why do some put only one cookie on defense?
posts.summary_en: Some players leave a 1-cookie defense so they drop in points. That gets them easier opponents and revenge targets, and saves refreshing. 75232 and 75307 describe the same tanking.
mechanics: Matchmaking offers opponents near your own points. Tanking points with a weak defense makes later attacks easier.
rules: Defense and attack teams are independent; a defense can hold anywhere from 1 to 12 cookies.

quotes.kr: 일부러 점수떨궈서 치기 좋은 상대들만 만나게 하는것도 있고 복수컨 노리고
quotes.en: They drop points on purpose to meet easy opponents, or to farm revenge fights.

posts.summary_en: After 260 fights with a 12.12M Rye/Espresso ranged deck, the poster reports luck-dependent wins up to 20M and a ceiling of about 1,900 pts at 12M. Espresso fights on the front line, which makes the deck weak to Moon Rabbit. When Pomegranate's buff lands on Macaron, Macaron keeps about 300 crit even under Moon Rabbit. Pinot is kept at Lv.99 deliberately so that Pomegranate targets Macaron. The screenshot shows a +6 win value against a 14.23M, 1,572-pt defense.

teams.name: Rye/Espresso ranged deck (내일뭐함)

cookies.note: ends up on the front line; weak to Moon Rabbit
Lv.99 on purpose so Pomegranate's buff goes to Macaron

pets: 갓난갓방울 20 (icon read as Holy Baby Drop)
teams.formation: 2 rows of 6 as shown on the attack-team card
teams.why: Ranged-damage deck without Bari; wins through Macaron crit plus Pomegranate buff routing.
unorthodox: Pinot Noir held at Lv.99 to steer Pomegranate's buff onto Macaron.

counters.why: Espresso sits on the front line and is exposed to Moon Rabbit's ATK and crit reduction.

builds.gear: standard arena set (흔한 아레나셋), not evasion
builds.why: When Macaron gets Pomegranate's buff it holds about 300 crit even under Moon Rabbit.

mechanics: Pomegranate's buff target can be steered by cookie level or ATK order; the poster lowered Pinot to Lv.99 so Macaron receives it.
rules: Win value shown before a fight (승리 시 획득 +6).

results.note: about 1,900 pts is the ceiling at 12M; occasional wins vs 20M

quotes.kr: 에소가 앞라인이라 달토끼한테 많이 취약함
quotes.en: Espresso ends up front line, so it's very vulnerable to Moon Rabbit.

quotes.kr: 마카롱한테 석류 줄려고
quotes.en: (Pinot at 99) so Pomegranate goes to Macaron.

posts.summary_en: A 12.28M Wizard (마법사맛 쿠키) deck tested over about 100 fights. It reliably beats equal-power teams and teams 2–3M stronger, and wins most bigger gaps if it survives the first 10 seconds. Early-sweep Bari decks kill it instantly. Strawberry Crepe can be swapped for Ion; Crepe wins more against Moon Rabbit. In the damage charts Wizard does 1.75–2.33M per fight and out-damages everything, beating Brightseeker, Rye, Espresso and Wind Archer decks of 17–21M.

teams.name: Wizard underdog deck (내친구, 하늘)

cookies.note: Lv.91; swap for Ion if the enemy has no Moon Rabbit

teams.why: Wizard's burst out-damages every enemy DPS once the fight lasts past about 10 s; the 30% DR buff makes that survival likely.
unorthodox: Hound Lv.82, Pinot Lv.92, Crepe Lv.91

counters.why: Bari decks wipe it in the opening seconds, before Wizard gets going.
Wizard's AoE out-damages their carries once the fight passes about 10 s.
counters.conditions: Equal power to +3M is near-certain; larger gaps win if it survives 10 s

mechanics: Fights are timed: the in-battle clock counts down from about 60 s (seen at 50.2 s, 47.9 s, 44.4 s). Speeds are x0.5/x1/x1.5/x2, and there is a 연속 도전 (auto-repeat) toggle and a skip.
The stats screen lists all 12 cookies (it scrolls), so 12-cookie teams fight in full.
rules: Battle length is about 60 s with a visible timer; speed-up to x2 is allowed.

results.note: beat 17.01M, 18.6M, 19.17M, 20.03M and 21.35M opponents in the screenshots

quotes.kr: 투력 차이나도 처음 10초만 버티면 대부분 이김
quotes.en: Even with a power gap, it mostly wins if it survives the first 10 seconds.

quotes.kr: 상대 달토끼 있으면 딸크쓰는게 승률높음
quotes.en: If the enemy has Moon Rabbit, Strawberry Crepe gives a higher win rate.

posts.summary_en: 설화 (then #4, 2,521 pts) runs Bari + Strawberry Crepe + Cherry Cola + Doughnut King + Macaron + Moon Rabbit + Hound + Ion. It crushes Bari+Oven decks but gets beaten by any deck with Rye. It beat the then-#1 Bari deck (while 2M lower). It can't beat a Brightseeker/Pinot/Rye/Macaron/Doughnut/Hound/Moon Rabbit/Ion deck even when 2M higher. The leaderboard screenshot shows the top 5 on 09-23 18:52: ㄹㄹ노아 2,614, 타미 2,594, 워터원 2,540, 설화 2,521, 검은반장 2,517.

cookies.note: 4 more slots not visible in the stats screenshot

counters.beaten_by: Rye decks with Moon Rabbit + Ion front
counters.why: Moon Rabbit plus Ion hold the charge wave while Rye shoots; a commenter calls it the Moon Rabbit + Ion + Rye combo.

mechanics: Commenter: Strawberry Crepe pushes the enemy front line together, which lets Cherry Cola and Bari shred them. Another commenter: if the burst doesn't kill fast, the enemy gets Milk's buff and turns the fight.
disagreements: Crepe: one commenter says it's bad because it pushes the front line away; another says it groups enemies for Cherry Cola and Bari.

quotes.kr: 바리+오방덱은 개잡듯이 패는데 호밀 들어간 덱한텐 개맞듯이 맞음
quotes.en: It beats Bari+Oven decks like dogs, but gets beaten like a dog by any deck with Rye.

quotes.kr: 달토끼 + 이온 + 호밀 콤보라 못 이기는 게 당연해보임
quotes.en: Moon Rabbit + Ion + Rye combo, so naturally you can't win.

posts.summary_en: Leaderboard on day 1 (09-23 17:42): 1 검은반장 2,537 (12 Lv.100 cookies), 2 타미 2,504 (12), 3 섬영 2,442 (9 cookies plus 3 empty slots). Pets are Lv.20. A commenter notes the #1 team had no Charge cookie despite the Charge buff. Another says Skill Haste on Oven makes it rush out alone before the buffs land.

builds.why: With haste it runs ahead alone before the buffs land.

mechanics: Charge cookies run in from their slot; too much haste or speed makes them engage before Milk and Pomegranate buffs land.
rules: Leaderboard shows each player's 12 defense slots and 3 pets; empty slots are allowed.

quotes.kr: 스가주면 버프전에 혼자 튀어 나갈 것 같던데
quotes.en: Give it Skill Haste and it seems to run out alone before the buffs.

posts.title_en: Is this the high-end arena deck?
posts.summary_en: Lists the lineup that the whole Rumble top tier ran on day 1: Macaron, Oven Wanderer, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Bari, Milk, Hound, Ion, Cherry Cola, Herb, Moon Rabbit. Commenters frame it as the Charge cookies' revolt, enabled by the Rumble buff.

teams.name: Oven–Bari 12-cookie charge deck (day-1 top-tier consensus)
teams.formation: the slot order matches crumb.gg's grid order for this deck
teams.why: Charge HP +30% makes Oven, Bari and Cherry Cola survive the dive; supports buff them.

quotes.kr: 와글와글 상위권 전부다 이거던데
quotes.en: Everyone in the Rumble top tier is running this.

posts.title_kr: 와레나 바리 성급 낮아도 걍 써야되네
posts.title_en: Use Bari in Rumble even at low stars
posts.summary_en: A 2★ Bari deck won with Bari doing 2.03M damage, beating a Wind Archer / Brightseeker / Cooling Mint deck. The poster posted the full lineup: Macaron, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Oven, Cheesecake, Bari, Hound, Cherry Cola, Moon Rabbit, with pets Icy Birdie (no Majestic King Choco Drop), Hot Doggie and Holy Baby Drop. Commenters disagree on whether Rye decks still beat it.

teams.name: Oven–Bari charge deck, 2★ Bari (물참피)
teams.formation: row order from the 74481 attack-team card (13.88M)
teams.why: The Charge season buff makes charge divers tanky; Bari's damage is high.
unorthodox: Icy Birdie in place of Majestic King Choco Drop

counters.team: Wind Archer / Brightseeker / Cooling Mint ranged deck
counters.why: The charge dive reaches the backline carries first.

disagreements: One commenter says Rye would have beaten it; another says Rye decks were wiped out of the Rumble top ranks; the poster says it beats Rye too.

quotes.kr: 마카롱 피노 석류 우유 이온 허브 오방 치케 바리 들개 체콜 달토끼 얼음과자새(초코왕방울 없어서) 핫도그 갓방울
quotes.en: Macaron Pinot Pomegranate Milk Ion Herb Oven Cheesecake Bari Hound Cherry-Cola Moon-Rabbit; Icy Birdie (no King Choco Drop), Hot Doggie, Holy Baby Drop.

posts.title_en: Switched Arena to the charge deck and won streaks
posts.summary_en: The same player (물참피) moved the Rumble charge deck into regular Arena and started winning. The attack-team card shows 13.88M, 1,871 pts, all Lv.100, pets Icy Birdie 19, Hot Doggie 20, Holy Baby Drop 20. Oven runes are 피감 치피 because the poster hasn't optimised them yet.

posts.title_en: The Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola deck is fun
posts.summary_en: Three win screens with a Bari (3★ visible)–Oven–Cherry Cola deck (Ion Lv.90). It beat a Rye/Pinot/Hound/Skating Queen deck, a Brightseeker/Wind Archer/Milky Way/Crepe deck and a mirror Bari/Brightseeker/Oven deck. Bari, Oven and Cherry Cola top the damage each time (1.1–2.1M each). The poster says it also beats non-charge decks 3M stronger.

quotes.kr: 돌격덱 아닌넘들 +3m도 이겼음
quotes.en: Beat non-charge decks even at +3M.

posts.title_kr: 소과금은 와레나 이 덱이 베스트 인듯?
posts.title_en: For light spenders this is the best Rumble deck?
posts.summary_en: 러너 (a known top player) copies a gallery Rye deck; his 18.77M version won against a 27M Oven/Bari/Brightseeker deck with Rye doing 2.29M. He calls it the best deck without Brightseeker or Bari, with high attack and defense win rates. The formation screen shows the levels, the 'arena/Conquest' preset and the pets.

teams.name: F2P Rye deck (러너)

cookies.note: Grapevine heals give mid-spec Rye decks time to turn the fight (75553)
was ATK% runes; about to change

teams.why: Rye carries; Moon Rabbit, Hound and Ion hold the dive; Grapevine and Herb sustain.
unorthodox: Several sub-100 levels (Doughnut 96, Hound 88, Pinot 94, Ion 83); per 75189 and 73955, lower-level or low-ATK supports are how players steer Pomegranate's buff onto Rye

counters.why: Rye plus the Moon Rabbit/Hound/Ion front outlasts the dive (Rye 2.29M, Hound 1.30M damage).

builds.sugar_runes: ATK% (공증) at the time; poster planned to change

quotes.kr: 시커 바리 없는 덱 중 베스트 인 듯
quotes.en: Seems the best among decks without Brightseeker or Bari.

posts.summary_en: A 12.92M Rye deck holds well against Bari–Oven–Cherry Cola in Rumble (wins at +2 to +6M, once at 20M). The same deck in the poster's own server's regular Arena loses to the same archetype 3M lower, dying within 0.5 s. The poster suspects the Rumble 30% DR buff is the difference.

counters.why: Survives the opening burst in Rumble (30% DR) and then out-damages; in regular Arena it gets deleted in 0.5 s.

mechanics: The same matchup flips between Rumble and regular Arena. That points to the 30% all-cookie DR buff blunting the charge opener.
disagreements: A commenter says the enemy's power is just inflated by high-power, low-value gear (뻥투템세팅).

quotes.kr: 와레나에서는 겁나잘버팀. 카운터수준.
quotes.en: In Rumble it holds amazingly, counter-level.

posts.summary_en: With an evasion set (1,005 evasion vs the enemy's 950 accuracy), an 8.41M Rye + Vampire deck beat a 16.53M opponent easily; commenters credit Vampire. It won all 5 revenge fights. The poster runs 스증 스가 피감 회피 and prefers DMG reduction over crit resistance because of Moon Rabbit.

teams.name: Vampire evasion Rye deck

cookies.note: water element, green hair; possibly 메론소다맛 쿠키

teams.why: Evasion stacked above enemy accuracy; Vampire.

counters.why: Enemy accuracy (950) below own evasion (1,005), plus Vampire.

builds.sugar_runes: 스증 스가 피감 회피; drop crit resistance for DMG reduction
builds.why: Moon Rabbit makes crit resistance less useful than DMG reduction (poster).

mechanics: Evasion versus accuracy decides whether hits land (see 75453 and 71672 for thresholds).
rules: 5 attack presets; win value varies (+10 against a 2,021-pt defense).
disagreements: A commenter says 950 accuracy vs 1,005 evasion should hardly matter and suspects Vampire instead.

posts.summary_en: The poster runs the Bari–Oven charge deck (돌장연) with evasion gear, about 1,350 evasion in battle at 15.5M. He takes no damage at equal power and beats +2–3M. Replies: accuracy of about 1,000–1,050 is typical (bow at +15–21), top players use +20 bows, and many carry one accuracy line. Evasion is better on attack presets than on defense.

builds.why: Opponents in cross-server matchmaking can't scout you, so evasion surprises them.

mechanics: Typical accuracy is about 1,000 (bow +15, 1–2 accuracy lines) to 1,050 (bow +21). Evasion needs to exceed it clearly.
disagreements: 71672: evasion needs to be about 400 above enemy accuracy to matter; 75453 and 74627 report it working at small margins.

quotes.kr: 방덱으로 고정하는거 아니면야 , 공격용도로 쓰면 되잖아? 프셋 5개 많긴 해
quotes.en: If not on defense, just use it for attack; 5 presets is plenty. (the #1 player)

posts.title_en: Time to bring out the evasion set
posts.summary_en: Plans a Vampire evasion deck for Rumble. A commenter says evasion must be about 400 above enemy accuracy to matter.
mechanics: Claimed evasion threshold: about +400 over enemy accuracy (unverified).

posts.title_kr: 님들아 와레나 랭커들 다 아레나셋이 아니라 스테셋쓰는거 같던데 이유기뭐임
posts.title_en: Why do Rumble rankers use stage sets, not arena sets?
posts.summary_en: Observation that Rumble rankers appear to use their stage (accuracy) gear preset. 76490 says the same; a reply suggests it's to counter evasion decks.

builds.gear: stage preset (accuracy-heavy) instead of arena preset
builds.why: Probably to beat evasion decks (76490, commenter).

disagreements: 73554: switch from the stage set to the arena set, otherwise you lose to equal power. Rankers reportedly do the opposite.

posts.title_en: Don't forget this for your Rumble deck
posts.summary_en: Reminder to swap gear from the stage preset to the arena preset. The poster kept losing to equal-power opponents while still on the stage set.

builds.gear: equip the arena preset (장비 프리셋), not the stage preset
builds.why: Equal power but losing while on the stage set

mechanics: Gear presets apply per team; the power figure doesn't reveal which set is on.

posts.summary_en: Rumble rankers sit around 27–30M. A reply says they use stage sets, perhaps because of evasion decks.
ㄹㄹ노아 (3rd at the time, 25.35M) faced a hidden opponent. A commenter identifies the two as ㄹㄹ노아 and 타미. He says someone is at 30M, yet that 30M player can still be beaten.

posts.title_en: Spent the day researching cross-server arena decks
posts.summary_en: ㄹㄹ노아 (곰인형) spent the day testing decks, with Bari 6★ and Moon Rabbit 7★. The screenshot shows a loss at 25.35M against 27.54M: −5 points (2,614), rank unchanged at 3rd.
rules: A loss at the top costs about −5 points (score drop shown on the DEFEAT screen).

quotes.kr: 바리6성, 달토끼7성으로도 열시미 했다규
quotes.en: Worked hard even with Bari 6★ and Moon Rabbit 7★.

posts.title_kr: 근데 와레나도 바리덱이 호밀한테 개털리는거 맞음?
posts.title_en: Do Bari decks really get wrecked by Rye in Rumble too?
posts.summary_en: The gallery says Rye + Ion + Rockstar wrecks Bari, yet no top Rumble player (SR all 10★) uses a Rye defense. Consensus in the replies: Rye is stronger at mid-to-upper spec, but Bari decks win at whale top-end. Against max-spec Bari, the buffed divers ('빨대 맞고 쳐들어오는 근숭이') kill everything on contact. At mid spec, Grapevine healing gets a window and Rye turns the fight.

counters.beaten_by: Rye + Ion + Rockstar / Grapevine Rye decks
counters.why: The dive doesn't kill instantly, so Grapevine heals and Rye out-damages.
Pomegranate-buffed divers delete the backline on contact.

disagreements: Whether Rye counters Bari depends on the spec bracket.

quotes.kr: 중상위권 정도에서는 호밀덱이 더 쌔고, ㄹㅇ 핵고래 최상위 랭킹은 바리덱이 쌤
quotes.en: Around mid-upper ranks the Rye deck is stronger; at the very top among mega-whales, the Bari deck is.

posts.title_en: Of course Bari is strong in Rumble, it's pampered
posts.summary_en: Bari decks are strong in Rumble because of the Charge buff, but not to the same degree in regular Arena, where Rye decks have the matchup edge unless spec is overwhelming.

counters.why: matchup edge without the Rumble buff

mechanics: Bari's Rumble strength is partly buff-driven; commenters expect it to fall off when the Charge buff rotates out.

posts.title_kr: 걍 뭔가 와레나 점수 올리기가 쉬운데?
posts.summary_en: Keep three attack presets and pick by matchup: the Rye deck beats Bari decks, the Crepe–Espresso deck beats Rye decks, and the Bari deck beats Crepe–Espresso decks. The Crepe–Espresso deck is the old '5-Ranged perk' deck: Crepe, Espresso, Rye, Pure Vanilla (바궁), Milky Way, Milk, Pomegranate, Macaron, Pinot, Doughnut King, Hound, Ion.
disagreements: The poster says his defense doesn't hold; this is an attack-side rotation.

quotes.kr: 바리덱 호밀덱으로 잡고 호밀덱 딸크 에소덱으로 잡고 딸크 에소덱 바리덱으로 잡고
quotes.en: Beat Bari with Rye, beat Rye with Crepe-Espresso, beat Crepe-Espresso with Bari.

posts.title_kr: 아레나 팔꺼면 마카롱 공퍼 슈가룬이 맞긴 한 듯
posts.title_en: If you're serious about arena, ATK% runes on Macaron
posts.summary_en: Explains ATK-order routing in a Rye deck: Macaron, Rye, Brightseeker (or Milky Way), Doughnut King, Pinot, Cheesecake, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Herb, Hound. The top three by ATK must be Milk > Rye ≥ Pomegranate so Pomegranate's buff lands on Rye. Hound should out-ATK Milky Way so Macaron's crit buff routes correctly and everything funnels to Rye. A variant against Bari drops Wind Archer and Brightseeker for Moon Rabbit and Grapevine. A commenter's Bari deck deleted this old ranker deck in about 1 s in Rumble.

teams.name: ATK-order Rye deck (티노씨)
teams.why: Funnel Pomegranate and Macaron buffs onto Rye by ATK order.

builds.why: ATK-order routing, and Rye, Macaron and Milk getting Pomegranate's buff at the start

mechanics: Pomegranate's buff (빨대) and Macaron's crit buff pick targets by ATK ranking; players tune runes and levels to make the carry receive them.
disagreements: The poster says the deck lost strength after the update.

quotes.kr: 공 높은 순으로 우유>호밀>=석류 이 3명이 제일 높아야함
quotes.en: By ATK, Milk > Rye ≥ Pomegranate must be the top 3.

posts.title_en: 5★ Bari users: do you route Pomegranate onto Bari?
posts.summary_en: To make Bari rather than Cherry Cola receive Pomegranate's buff, you'd strip Cherry Cola's ATK and stack Bari's. The reply: at 5★ you have to give up on the buff.
mechanics: Pomegranate's buff goes to the highest-ATK ally (implied).
disagreements: 75083: Bari 5★ is enough but must receive Pomegranate's buff. 74618 reply: at 5★, give up on the buff.

posts.summary_en: Mixed views. One side: Bari is broken in Arena too, 5★ is enough and 10★ is for arena bullies, and she must receive Pomegranate's buff. The other side: not mandatory like Brightseeker, and she'll be benched once the Rumble Charge buff goes.
disagreements: Bari's must-have status is disputed; several commenters tie her Rumble value to the season-1 Charge buff.

quotes.kr: 5성만 해도 충분 근데 석류 빨대 꽂히게는 만들어야됨
quotes.en: 5★ is enough, but you must make Pomegranate's straw land on her.

posts.summary_en: Reply: you need about Oven 7★ and Bari 5★ to hold your own in Arena, and without Bari you skip Oven too.
mechanics: Star thresholds cited: Oven Wanderer 7★ and Princess Bari 5★.

quotes.kr: 오방7 바리5정도 달아야 아레나에서 사람구실해
quotes.en: Oven 7★, Bari 5★ to be viable in arena.

posts.summary_en: A no-Bari Rumble lineup from a regular: Macaron, Doughnut King, Pinot, Pomegranate, Milk, Ion, Rye, Melon Soda, Cheesecake, Espresso, Hound, Moon Rabbit, with pets Holy Baby Drop, Hot Doggie and Chargemellow.

posts.title_en: Why don't Rumble rankers use Bari and Moon Rabbit?
posts.summary_en: Commenters explain Moon Rabbit. It gets blocked in front by cookies that dive in, like Charles or Ion, so it often can't reach the backline. But landing its ATK-down on Milk alone pays for the slot: Milk's ATK buff collapses and the whole enemy damage line drops.
mechanics: Moon Rabbit applies ATK reduction; hitting the enemy Milk shrinks Milk's ATK% buff and so the whole team's damage.
Moon Rabbit can be blocked by front-line divers (Ion and others) before reaching the backline.

quotes.kr: 달토끼는 우유 공깍만 걸어도 1인분임
quotes.en: Moon Rabbit earns its slot just by putting ATK-down on Milk.

posts.title_en: Moon Rabbit and Princess Bari skill coefficients (leak)
posts.summary_en: Client-datamined values (poster says rough): Bari 9★ gives DMG reduction 40%; Moon Rabbit 9★ gives ATK reduction 50%, crit reduction 130% and range 4.2. Commenters conclude crit damage becomes nearly worthless against Moon Rabbit and evasion may replace crit resistance.
mechanics: Leak, low confidence: Princess Bari 9★ DMG reduction 40%.
Leak, low confidence: Moon Rabbit 9★ ATK reduction 50%, crit reduction 130%, range about 4.2.

quotes.kr: 바리공주 9성 : 피감 40% 달토끼 9성 : 공감 50% 치명감소 130% 범위 4.2?
quotes.en: Bari 9★: DMG reduction 40%. Moon Rabbit 9★: ATK down 50%, crit reduction 130%, range 4.2?

posts.summary_en: Asked for Oven Wanderer runes in Rumble, the one reply says defensive lines are the right call.

rules: Defense wins pay Rumble medals (the icon was wrong at launch).

posts.title_en: No points for losing in Rumble?
posts.summary_en: The question implies attack losses give no reward points; nobody answered. 74344 shows a −5 score drop on a loss at rank 3.
rules: Attack losses cost rating points (−5 at the top, 74344).

posts.title_en: Only whales at the Master threshold

rules: Leagues include Platinum, Diamond (numbered, 다1 is the top division) and Master.

posts.summary_en: The top ranks mix players from early and late servers; the early servers didn't take over as expected. 75612 says the same.
A 4.19M team with Macaron, Pinot and Pomegranate (Lv.89) plus Doughnut Lv.90, Hound Lv.95 and Moon Rabbit Lv.95 (other slots unreadable) beat a 10.59M team. The poster credits Bari.

Players describe splitting decks by mode. One runs Rye in Rumble and Bari–Oven in regular Arena. Another says that from Bari 5★ up the charge deck is the stronger pick in regular Arena. A third says the matchup is decided by the gear gap.
disagreements: Whether Bari–Oven is better in Rumble or in regular Arena.

posts.title_en: Took the Rumble deck to regular Arena
posts.summary_en: A perennial #2 in regular Arena copied a Rumble top-ranked deck (they all use Bari) and started crushing his server's #1.
A 10M player lost to a 5M one. Replies point to charge decks with the +30% HP buff, and to the arena gear preset versus the stage preset.
mechanics: Displayed power predicts outcomes poorly (gear preset, charge buff).

posts.title_en: If Rumble had no charge buff
posts.summary_en: Without the Charge buff, a commenter says Rye would kill everything. Another says Rye can't be countered by a Charles deck or 색동 (Candy Shade Pouch).

posts.title_en: Why leave a weak Rumble defense open?
posts.summary_en: Tickets have to be bought with mileage, unlike regular Arena. Keeping a real defense to hold points beats becoming a free target.
rules: Tickets are scarcer than in regular Arena; extras cost mileage.

posts.summary_en: The Oven–Bari deck is absurd; a reply attributes it to the Charge buff.

posts.title_en: Rumble top 3 all run Oven Wanderer
posts.summary_en: On day 1 the top 3 all ran Oven Wanderer. The poster says it only works with the TSSR support cookie (Bari) and the season buff.

posts.title_en: A 5★ Bari deck one-shots a 10★ Brightseeker deck
posts.summary_en: In regular Arena, a 5★ Bari deck deletes Brightseeker ranged decks 3–4M stronger on contact.
A paid Rumble pass exists (19,000 KRW per 73476). Players are unsure whether it's needed to empty the Rumble shop.
rules: A paid Rumble pass (와글 패스, 19,000 KRW per the 73476 title) exists; a cheaper Rumble pass was added to the low-spender pack (74404 title).

posts.summary_en: The Rumble exchange sells dough-dungeon and coin-dungeon keys (10 per reset), which are the best value. 76393 recommends keys first (dough > gold > XP), then Stella rune auto-rewards, after chocolate bars and syrup.
rules: The exchange (교환소) sells daily-dungeon keys, chocolate bars, syrup and Stella sugar-rune auto-rewards for Rumble medals.

rules: The Rumble shop sells a random box: SR 0.20%, R 78.68%, U 21.12%.
